newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar prices extend declines.
newsitem.headline: India sugar prices extend declines.

text.p: Sugar prices extended declines as consumer and retail demand backed off while stockists and millers increased offers, traders said.
Ready delivery Sugar S30 fell by 13/16 rupees to 1252/1280 per quintal ,while M30 fell by 5/12 to 1300/1380 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery for the second half of current month fell by 20/25 rupees to 1190/1210 rupees per quintal.
Sugar was down by 5/15 per quintal on Thursday.
Earlier this week the market was firm following a hike in prices of sugar supplied through a public distribution system but profit-taking and buyer resistance capped the rally.
Overall sentiment was subdued at the close and volume was low amid scattered physical enquiries.
